decisions.title: TLS certificate generation: ECDSA P-256 + 10yr CA / 1yr leaf
decisions.decision: Generate ECDSA P-256 CA (10yr) and leaf cert (1yr) with proper SANs. Idempotent: skip if cert has >30 days remaining.
decisions.rationale: ECDSA P-256 is the browser-compatible modern choice. 10yr CA avoids frequent re-trust. 30-day threshold matches Let's Encrypt renewal convention.

decisions.title: cosign keyless NOT used — ed25519 in-house verification
decisions.decision: Use ed25519 in-house signature verification instead of cosign keyless infrastructure.
decisions.rationale: Per v1 drift decision in project MEMORY: VISION明文のcosign keyless / zitadel/oidcは使わずin-house実装で出荷確定。The interface boundary allows v1.x substitution.

decisions.title: ACME provider registry uses init() auto-registration pattern
decisions.decision: DNSProvider registry is populated via init() in provider packages. Main imports blank `_ .../acme/providers` to trigger all registrations.
decisions.rationale: Consistent with existing DNS provider pattern in the codebase (acme.Register). Avoids manual wiring per provider. New providers added by creating a new file with init().

decisions.title: KURA_ACME_STAGING=1 short-circuits real Cloudflare API in CI
decisions.decision: Cloudflare provider checks KURA_ACME_STAGING env and returns nil without making network calls when set.
decisions.rationale: Prevents CI from consuming Cloudflare API quota. Test gate allows unit tests to verify registration and token-loading logic without live network.

decisions.title: KURA_NETWORK_APPLY=1 gate: GenerateNetplan is always testable
decisions.decision: ApplyConfig always generates YAML (can be tested in dry-run). netplan apply + hostnamectl only execute when KURA_NETWORK_APPLY=1 is set.
decisions.rationale: Allows full YAML generation testing in local CI without a real netplan system. VM smoke test sets the gate. Matches pattern from existing code (KURA_NETWORK_APPLY described in E2E test comments).

decisions.title: Netplan SSOT: only engine/network writes /etc/netplan/99-kura.yaml
decisions.decision: A single netplan file (99-kura.yaml) is owned exclusively by the kura engine. Other files in /etc/netplan are untouched.
decisions.rationale: Avoids conflict with cloud-init and OS-managed netplan files. 99- prefix gives highest numeric priority in netplan merge order.

decisions.title: JSONL daily-rotated log files with configurable retention
decisions.decision: Each day gets its own .jsonl file (kura-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl). Retention pruning removes oldest files when count exceeds LoggingConfig.RetentionDays.
decisions.rationale: JSONL is streamable and grep-friendly. Daily rotation keeps files manageable. File-count-based retention is simpler than byte-size and matches common log rotation tools.

decisions.title: SSE log stream uses Go 1.22 mux path specificity for routing
decisions.decision: Register /ui/admin/settings/logs/stream as a separate explicit route, not a sub-path of the settings wildcard.
decisions.rationale: Go 1.22 net/http mux selects most-specific path. Avoids intercepting SSE handshake with the general settings handler which sets wrong content-type headers.

decisions.title: Self-update Apply goroutine: returns 'applying' immediately, no blocking
decisions.decision: handleApply launches Updater.Apply in a goroutine and returns an HTMX partial with 'applying...' status. The update proceeds asynchronously.
decisions.rationale: HTTP request would time out during a multi-second binary download + restart + health poll. Non-blocking response with SSE-friendly pattern fits htmx usage.

decisions.title: Rollback path: kura.bak → kura on health-poll failure
decisions.decision: After atomic replace (kura.bak, kura.new→kura), poll /healthz for up to 5s. On failure: rm kura, mv kura.bak→kura. No systemctl restart needed — supervisor (nohup/systemd) will restart.
decisions.rationale: Minimal rollback surface. kura.bak preserved until next successful update. Health poll 5s matches typical Go binary startup time on slow hardware.
